KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Return.1: The jewellery box sits quietly, the velvet slot empty.
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Return.2: The music lingers faintly in the air. A memory of Ghornfell, long past.
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Return.3: The story has been heard, but the melody remains.
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Intro.1: The broken melody urges you towards the music box. The contraption looks unfinished, with a round slot where an item might rest.
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Intro.2: Something is inscribed on the front.
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Riddle1.1: "Fire burns, the great earth shakes. Water sloshes into lakes."
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Riddle1.2: "Nature stitches up the seams. Law tempers its dreams."
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Riddle1.3: "Around them all, a single band. A twinkling star upon the hand."
KeysToEntries.Player.InspiringRing.1: Place the inspiring ring of runecrafting?
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.PlayOn.1: The melody from the box plays on.
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.PlacedRing.1: The ring clicks into place. Something inside the box whirrs, rotates, and reveals a second slot.
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Riddle2.1: "Ashenfall, I must confide, that while you wait and dream and hide,"
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Riddle2.2: "Magic is growing ever stronger. I fear you won't contain it any longer."
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.Riddle2.3: "This is the cant that I expressed, as I wore magic's eye upon my breast."
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.PlacedAmulet.1: You socket the amulet into the slot. The melody stops.
KeysToEntries.Player.Jewellery.PlacedAmulet.2: A compartment opens, revealing your reward.
KeysToEntries.Player.NoInventory.1: A reward is waiting for you here, but you have no space in your inventory.
KeysToEntries.QuestDesc: A jewellery box in Ghornfell plays a haunting melody, but it cannot complete its song.
KeysToEntries.QuestObjective.1: The jewellery box requires a specific ring.
KeysToEntries.QuestObjective.2: The jewellery box requires a specific amulet.
